summary: Corteva, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, detailing the completion of its spin-off of the seed operating segment into Vylor Inc. The separation was effected via a pro rata distribution of all Vylor common shares to Corteva holders of record as of September 24, 2026, with distribution effective at 12:03 a.m. ET on October 1, 2026. Vylor shares began regular-way trading on the NYSE under symbol VYLR. Ancillary agreements—Separation and Distribution, Tax Matters, Employee Matters, Reverse Transition Services, Intellectual Property, and Supply—govern the relationship. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or premium was stated. The spin-off resulted in two independent, publicly traded companies. Watch post-separation trading dynamics, index inclusion, and execution of transition agreements.
